1. Google EmbeddingGemma 2

Tagline: An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
Description: EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google DeepMind’s open embedding model that maps text, code, images, video and audio into one shared space, so you can search across them from a single query. At 740M parameters it runs on-device, needing about 567MB of RAM on a Pixel 11 Pro for the full multimodal model (191MB for text only). Apache 2.0 licensed, with weights on Hugging Face and Kaggle. MTEB Code score rises from 68.76 to 78.68.
Website: open

7. Hexis Cloud

Tagline: One company brain for all your AI agents
Description: Hexis is one company brain for your team and all its AI agents. Through Hexis, your team can align on shared context that’s important to align on, non-technical teams can work and collaborate on skills and your team can have hundreds of tools accessible via one MCP gateway. All the information is owned by someone, meaning it’s context you can trust, and Hexis enables access control to a single file. It only takes a few minutes to set up, and is free for up to 3 people. Would love your feedback!
